title: How Facebook's Algorithmic Tweaks Affected Engagement with News URLs over Time
snippet: A detailed media summary and liveblog write-up of Fabio Giglietto's presentation at the International Communication Association (ICA) 2026 conference in Cape Town. It highlights Giglietto's computational social science research analyzing over 130,000 news URLs on Facebook, explaining findings like the 'partisan penalty' where heavy sharing by highly partisan audiences actually results in a reduction of reach due to platform algorithm adjustments.
description: A detailed third-party liveblog coverage of Fabio Giglietto's presentation at the ICA 2026 conference, detailing his computational research on Facebook's algorithms and the 'partisan penalty' effect on news engagement.

title: Algoritmi e democrazia, il caso Meta secondo lo studio di UniUrb

title: Secondo uno studio dell'università di Urbino l'algoritmo di Facebook ora punisce la politica ufficiale e premia gli estremisti antieuropei. Pd e FdI verso una legge bipartisan sulle piattaforme
snippet: A news article reporting on a study led by Professor Fabio Giglietto of the University of Urbino. The study revealed that Meta's political content reduction policy severely diminished the reach of official political figures in Italy (by up to 73.4% compared to 2021) while inadvertently boosting extremist and eurosceptic accounts.
description: A news article covering a research study co-authored by Fabio Giglietto from the University of Urbino concerning the impact of Facebook's algorithm on the visibility of political discourse and extremist content.
